message.content:
Here’s a mix‑and‑match lineup that will keep you on edge all weekend long—spooky classics, slick modern thrillers, and one or two cult gems that still pack a punch:

| # | Title & Year | Sub‑Genre / Tone | Why It Works for a Friday Night |
|---|--------------|------------------|--------------------------------|
| **1** | *Hereditary* (2018) | Psychological/Family Horror | A slow burn that turns into an unrelenting nightmare; perfect if you want something that lingers after the credits roll. |
| **2** | *Get Out* (2017) | Social Thriller/Horror Comedy | Sharp satire meets genuine terror – great conversation starter before midnight snacks. |
| **3** | *A Quiet Place* (2018) | Survival/Fantasy | Silence becomes your biggest threat; it’ll have everyone glued to their seats—and whispering at each other! |
| **4** | *It Follows* (2014) | Supernatural/Survival | That creeping dread feels like a real-life curse—ideal for late‑night chills. |
| **5** | *Midsommar* (2019) | Folk Horror | Bright daylight horrors flip expectations; it’s unsettling without being too gory. |
| **6** | *The Conjuring* (2013) | Paranormal Investigation | Classic haunted house vibes with solid pacing—a reliable crowd‑pleaser. |
| **7** | *Suspiria* (1977) | Gothic Art House | If you’re up for surreal visuals and haunting music, this Italian masterpiece keeps things off‑beat. |
| **8** | *Creep* (2000) | Found Footage | Low‑budget charm + creepy “real” vibe make it feel personal and unnerving. |
| **9** | *Evil Dead II* (1987) | Slasher/Comedy | Over-the-top gore mixed with campy humor—great for those who love a bit of fun between scares. |
| **10** | *The Babadook* (2014) | Psychological Family Horror | Intimate fear rooted in grief; its subtle creepiness works well when you’ve already had a few others. |

### Quick Streaming Guide (as of May 2026)

| Movie | Where to Watch |
|-------|---------------|
| Hereditary | HBO Max |
| Get Out | Netflix |
| A Quiet Place | Amazon Prime Video |
| It Follows | Hulu |
| Midsommar | Disney+ (Hulu) |
| The Conjuring | Paramount+ |
| Suspiria | Shudder |
| Creep | Shudder |
| Evil Dead II | Shudder |
| The Babadook | Apple TV+ |

Feel free to shuffle them around based on how intense you’d like the evening to get—or pair a lighter film early on and save the heavy hitters for later. Happy spooking!
